correctness.rationale: OU semigroup gives Gaussian endpoint mean mu exp(-z/2), variance D tau[q+(1-q)(1-exp(-z))]. Symmetric Gaussian KL yields exact P_{q,c}(z)=2q J(z)/z. Fixed-z limiting H_c(z)=(1-exp(-z)+c(1-exp(-z/2))²)/z has boundary value 1. Algebraic identity z-N_c(z)=[z-3+4exp(-z/2)-exp(-z)]+(2-c)(1-exp(-z/2))², with bracket derivative (1-exp(-z/2))²>0, proves strict H_c<1 for c<=2; when c>2, N_c changes sign once giving one positive optimum. Uniform small-z expansion P=1-(2-c)z/4+(1/6-c/8)z²-q/z+controlled remainders, plus maximizing-sequence localization, produces minimizers 2/sqrt(2-c) on sqrt(q) scale and 6^{1/3} on cube-root scale. The compactness argument handles all global maximizers. Independent numerical optimization at tiny q corroborates but is not proof. Cost is endpoint information divergence, not physical entropy production.
